nina: Quick sync / continuous batching tradeoffs: we need a narrow decision on caller hints vs server-only inference for long-running sequences.

alexa: Two concerns: packing efficiency (we lose utilization if server blind) vs fairness and gaming (clients will over-declare).

matt: What about a strictly-advisory hint that is audited? Server always has veto. Admission returns used_shape + confidence.

sam: Also add a soft-preempt checkpoint for KV cache. If we evict without a checkpoint costs explode on regen. Handshake: PREEMPT_INTENT -> CHECKPOINT_HANDLE or TIMEOUT -> FORCE_EVICT.

nina: Ops needs metrics: shape_hint_mismatch_rate, checkpoint_latency_ms, force_eviction_count. Also reserve a small-latency pool so interactive <64-token calls don't starve.

alexa: Decision sketch: accept advisory shape_hint, gate by per-caller trust_score, implement inflight token quota with early-reject (429 + retry-after), and add lightweight KV checkpoint handshake for soft-preempt.

matt: I'll draft the proto additions (used_shape, confidence, ticket_id) and post PR.

ci-bot: ci: scheduler-protos v4 pushed, unit tests passed :white_check_mark:, integration flaky on checkpoint tests :warning:

sam: I'll write the checkpoint sequence diagram and failure-mode notes.

nina: Thanks. If nobody objects I'll fold into RFC follow-up. tagging: @matt @alexa @sam
